blocks.title: What changed since the last Report

runs.text: CP-2 may consume the two historical conditional points, the funding-basis sensitivities, the definition differences and the countercase as restricted valuation context, preserving source dates, units, provenance and missing adjustments. It must not interpret either point as complete EV, collateral value, debt coverage, recovery, target price, current recommendation or proof of leverage capacity. It must not average the points, treat sensitivities as a range, or infer sector statistics from N=1. TDG EBITDA As Defined remains separate from the ordinary EBITDA transfer.

Before decision use, CP-2 needs fresh aligned evidence, a full capitalization/economic-claims bridge and earnings-quality work; subsequent events must remain dated and separate from FY2025. This handoff does not claim CP-2 has executed or consumed it. The separate existing delivery process should preserve this model-authored reasoning, figures, definitions, complete tables and restrictions in HTML without an analytical rerun, workbook, new engine or competing controller; no HTML delivery is claimed here.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: M/S are the supplied selected method/REF evidence associated with the requested cp-os `b57a344` ancestry; this is not an independently inspected repository checkout. Current six-section, retained-arithmetic and missingness instructions govern over historical full-run/export language. Where M and S present different register layouts, the consolidated selected-method columns in M p1 are used below.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Moog's dated common equity is USD6,483.777030m. Adding borrowing principal and finance leases and deducting reported non-restricted cash produces a **known-components EV proxy of USD7,501.839030m**, not complete EV. Its individual proxy multiples are **1.943167x FY2025 revenue** and **15.358427x the precisely defined pretax-plus-interest-plus-D&A proxy**. Applying these separately to TDG FY2025 revenue and ordinary EBITDA produces **USD17,160.112063m** and **USD70,157.294567m**, respectively [F pp1–8; C p1]. These are conditional enterprise-value-context indications, not endpoints of a valuation range.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The large difference is economically informative, not competing arithmetic: Moog's proxy EBITDA/revenue is 12.652126%, versus TDG ordinary EBITDA/revenue of 51.726871% (new tool ratios; trace below). A revenue multiple imports Moog's lower earnings per sales dollar; an EBITDA multiple scales TDG's much higher reported earnings base. Different commercial/defense/industrial exposure, margins and earnings definitions prevent treating either result as normalized fair value. TDG reports 60.1% gross margin; Moog reports 27.4% [F p4, L590 and L699]. Gross margins corroborate material business-economics differences but do not themselves bridge EBITDA definitions.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: **Strongest countercase:** Moog's lower-margin systems/industrial mix may make it a weak valuation anchor for TDG. If TDG's higher earnings conversion is durable and reflects differentiated aftermarket/product economics, the revenue transfer could materially understate economic value. Conversely, if TDG's margins or earnings quality deteriorate, transferring the same EBITDA multiple could overstate support. The retained pack does not quantify a matched aftermarket mix, pricing durability or normalized earnings bridge sufficient to decide between these cases. Consequently neither indication dominates, and averaging them would conceal rather than resolve the disagreement.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: For creditors, deterioration in commercial demand or program execution would first affect volumes, mix or contract costs; earnings and cash conversion could then weaken, impairing refinancing confidence. Monitor margin persistence, working-capital absorption, RPA availability and earnings-definition bridges before attaching valuation support to credit decisions. These sources do not supply a forecast, stress magnitude or resulting liquidity headroom.

fields.value: Retained multiplication evidence: A = 28,424,853 × USD204.64 = USD5,816,861,917.92; B = 3,237,452 × USD206.00 = USD666,915,112.00. Their sum divided by 1,000,000 is USD6,483.77702992m [C p1; F p2 L2349]. September 27 is the issuer's disclosed **as-of** price label, not proof of a Saturday exchange trade. Both filings became available after fiscal year-end; this is retrospective, not an executable September 2025 backtest [P]. Prices and financials are greater than twelve months old on 2026-11-05. C's native exclusion diagnostic used 2026-11-04; it was not rerun today. The later execution only increases staleness.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Full formula: **EV = common equity + debt + minority interests + preferred equity − cash/equivalents − eligible liquid available short-term investments** [S p2]. Complete EV is Not calculable because economic adjustments are not fully established. Chosen convention uses borrowing principal plus finance leases, excluding operating leases without a rent add-back. This is explicitly different from M's default balance-sheet carrying debt; that basis is shown separately.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: RPA proceeds are operating cash flows; USD125m is derecognized sold receivables, not GAAP borrowing. The subsidiary guarantees sold receivables and pledges assets; those assets are unavailable to other group creditors [R p1 L1436–1445].
